qualifications: Reference compute and synthetic routing; no hardware calibration.
Slot-full time reconstructed from SEND lifetimes; scheduler-ready reason is not directly logged.
Summed node waits and rank occupancy durations are not whole-round losses.
Same-time callbacks lack sub-nanosecond ordering; no complete critical-path claim.

archive.note: Public comparison output plus resource index; no simulations rerun or previous outputs removed.

resources.note: Snapshot excludes later delivery logs. Wall time includes cumulative disk scans; sampled group RSS may miss short child peaks. Waited-child ru_maxrss is a single-process high-water value, not a group peak.

final_resource_snapshot.note: Includes three main treatment runs, six independent workflow verification runs, old registered roots and analysis; small later delivery logs excluded.
